## The contract (generated from the runtime schemas)

- an extension's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1–40 characters, starting with a letter or digit; the id everywhere is `<name>@<source label>`; the reserved labels are `project`, `session`, `mercury`.
- ONE manifest, `mercury-extension.json`, at the extension root; every path in it stays inside the root.
- ONE catalogue, `mercury-extensions.json`, at a source root — or a single `mercury-extension.json` when the repository IS the extension.
- unknown top-level keys: a warning at load, an error under `mercury extensions validate`; unknown keys INSIDE `contributes`/`needs` are errors at load.
- `module` is reserved: this build loads declarative extensions; `module` is reserved.
- approval is per contributions hash — sha256 over the canonicalised `contributes` + `needs` blocks: a version bump alone carries approval over; a changed command line, server, or need re-asks.
- the substitutions: `${MERCURY_EXTENSION_ROOT}`, `${MERCURY_EXTENSION_DATA}`, `${option.KEY}` in command lines, args, env values and prompt bodies; every other `${…}` stays literal. Hooks and servers receive `MERCURY_EXTENSION_ROOT`, `MERCURY_EXTENSION_DATA` and one `MERCURY_EXTENSION_OPTION_<KEY>` per option; a `sensitive` option renders a visible placeholder in prose the model reads.

### `mercury-extension.json` — field by field

| field | shape | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The extension's name — half of its id (<name>@<source label>) and the namespace of every contribution. lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1–40 characters, starting with a letter or digit. |
| `version` | string | yes | Any non-empty string without whitespace. Keys updates and approval; Mercury detects "different", the catalogue says which is newer. |
| `description` | string | yes | One line, at most 200 characters; painted on the row. |
| `author` | object | no | Shown in the detail pane. |
| `author.name` | string | yes | The author's name. |
| `author.url` | string | no | The author's URL. |
| `homepage` | string | no | A URL, shown in the detail pane. |
| `license` | string | no | The licence identifier, shown in the detail pane. |
| `mercury` | string | no | A version floor (`>=x.y.z`). Unmet ⇒ broken with the reason "needs Mercury ≥ x.y.z". |
| `contributes` | object | no | What the extension adds to Mercury. Every kind mirrors what the operator can place by hand in the project config estate. |
| `contributes.skills` | list of string | no | Directories whose child directories each hold a SKILL.md — one skill each, registered as /<name>:<skill>. |
| `contributes.commands` | list of string | no | Directories of <cmd>.md prompt files (one level deep; a subdirectory namespaces /<name>:<dir>:<cmd>), registered as /<name>:<cmd>. |
| `contributes.agents` | list of string | no | Directories of <agent>.md definitions, registered as agent type <name>:<agent>. Privilege-raising frontmatter (permission mode, hooks, servers) is ignored with a health note. |
| `contributes.hooks` | map of name → list of object | no | Hook event name → matchers → command hooks, the operator's own hooks shape. The event names are the hook registry's list; a name outside it is skipped with a health note. |
| `contributes.servers` | map of name → object or object | no | MCP servers by short name, the operator's own server shape (stdio, http or sse). Connected as ext:<name>:<server>; their tools pass the permission engine like any MCP tool. |
| `contributes.language` | map of name → object | no | Language servers by short name, Mercury's language-server config shape. Started as ext:<name>:<server>. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.command` | string | yes | The executable to spawn (a bare name is looked up on PATH; an absolute path may contain spaces). |
| `contributes.language.<name>.args` | list of string | no | Arguments passed to the server. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.extensionToLanguage` | map of name → string | yes | File extension (with the dot) → language identifier; at least one entry. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.transport` | `stdio` · `socket` | no | 'stdio' (default) or 'socket'. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.env` | map of name → string | no | Environment for the spawned process. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.initializationOptions` | value | no | Server-specific `initialize` options (opaque). |
| `contributes.language.<name>.settings` | value | no | Server settings sent with `workspace/didChangeConfiguration` (opaque). |
| `contributes.language.<name>.workspaceFolder` | string | no | The workspace root to initialise the server with. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.startupTimeout` | integer | no | Milliseconds to wait for `initialize` before failing. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.shutdownTimeout` | integer | no | Milliseconds to wait for the graceful shutdown before the child is killed (default 2000). |
| `contributes.language.<name>.requestTimeout` | integer | no | Milliseconds a single request may wait for its answer before it is cancelled and refused (default 30000); one budget covers a whole call, retries included. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.restartOnCrash` | boolean | no | Whether a crashed server may restart lazily on next use (default true). |
| `contributes.language.<name>.maxRestarts` | integer | no | Cap on (re)start attempts before giving up. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.disabled` | boolean | no | Skip this server entirely (the row stays visible to status surfaces as disabled). |
| `contributes.language.<name>.diagnosticsOnly` | boolean | no | A linter-class lane: participates in document sync and diagnostics, never as the primary for navigation/refactor operations. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.idleTimeoutMs` | integer | no | Stop the server after this long with no requests; it restarts lazily on next use. |
| `contributes.language.<name>.rootMarkers` | list of string | no | Workspace files that mark a project this server owns ("Cargo.toml", "*.sln") — detection metadata for catalogue-style offers. |
| `contributes.channels` | list of object | no | Servers of this extension allowed to post channel messages into the session after approval. A server not declared here has its posts dropped with a health note. |
| `contributes.channels[].server` | string | yes | One of THIS extension's servers (its key under `servers`). |
| `contributes.channels[].label` | string | yes | How the channel is named on the approval card and in the session. |
| `contributes.keybindings` | map of name → string | no | Default chords → one of THIS extension's own commands or skills (`/<name>:…`). Applied only when the operator's keybindings leave the chord free. |
| `needs` | object | no | What the extension requires from the machine and the operator. |
| `needs.binaries` | list of string | no | Executables that must be on PATH. Probed at health time; missing ⇒ partial with "x not on PATH". |
| `needs.env` | list of string | no | Environment variables the extension reads. Probed; unset ⇒ partial with "X unset". |
| `needs.network` | list of string | no | Hosts it talks to. Informative: painted on the approval card and the detail pane; not enforced. |
| `needs.options` | map of name → object | no | Operator-configured values, collected on approval and editable later. Each reaches hooks as MERCURY_EXTENSION_OPTION_<KEY> and substitutes as `${option.KEY}`. |
| `needs.options.<name>.type` | `string` · `number` · `boolean` · `directory` · `file` | yes | The value kind the operator is asked for. |
| `needs.options.<name>.title` | string | no | The short label shown when the operator is asked. |
| `needs.options.<name>.description` | string | no | One line explaining what the value is for. |
| `needs.options.<name>.required` | boolean | no | A required option left empty makes the extension partial with the reason "option X not set". |
| `needs.options.<name>.default` | string or number or boolean or list of string | no | The value used until the operator sets one. |
| `needs.options.<name>.sensitive` | boolean | no | Stored in the secure store, never the settings file; never substituted into prose the model reads (a placeholder naming the key appears instead). |
| `needs.options.<name>.multiple` | boolean | no | Accept a list of values. |
| `needs.options.<name>.min` | number | no | Lower bound for a number option. |
| `needs.options.<name>.max` | number | no | Upper bound for a number option. |
| `module` | value | no | Reserved for the in-process code tier. this build loads declarative extensions; `module` is reserved. |

### `mercury-extensions.json` — field by field

| field | shape | required | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | The source's label: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1–40 characters, starting with a letter or digit; not one of the reserved labels project, session, mercury. Unique among the operator's sources. |
| `description` | string | no | One line about the source, shown in the sources list. |
| `homepage` | string | no | A URL for humans. |
| `extensions` | list of object | yes | The extensions this source offers. |
| `extensions[].name` | string | yes | The extension's name. Must equal the manifest's `name` — a mismatch is a lying catalogue and the install refuses. |
| `extensions[].version` | string | yes | The version offered. Must equal the manifest's `version` at that ref — a mismatch refuses the install. |
| `extensions[].description` | string | yes | One line, painted in the source view. |
| `extensions[].path` | string | no | Where the extension lives inside this source (`./review-tools`); never escapes the source root. Exactly one of `path` or `git`. |
| `extensions[].git` | string | no | A git URL when the extension lives in another repository; fetched only at install time, and the card names the URL first. Exactly one of `path` or `git`. |
| `extensions[].ref` | string | no | The branch or tag to fetch for a `git` entry. |

<!-- contract:end -->
